title: 龍總大廈 / 九龍總商會大廈 evidence ledger
purpose: Describe the identified building for a game/worldbuilding workbench; distinguish facts, drawing observations, inference and unknowns. Do not substitute this for building/fire-safety documentation.

verified_facts.claim: The whole building has 28 above-ground storeys: a 24-storey tower component over a 4-storey podium. One basement is recorded separately.
verified_facts.note: The 28-storey count is independently stated by KCC, not inferred from height. Floor labels and individual floor heights are separate questions.

verified_facts.claim: Both parts share lot KIL 1333 (RP) and occupation permit K42/84.
The occupation permit date is 1984-08-31 in Hong Kong. KCC states completion in September 1984.
verified_facts.note: These are distinct milestones, not necessarily a contradiction.

verified_facts.claim: Tower attributes: BaseHeight = 22.4, TopHeight = 90.9. Podium: BaseHeight = 8, TopHeight = 22.4.
verified_facts.note: Preserve the source fields. The tower attribute difference is 68.5 m, whereas the supplied local mesh span is 70.20 m. Do not force them to match or infer floor heights.

drawing_observations.claim: Both floor-plan ranges show six units, A–F, around the central circulation core.
drawing_observations.limit: Not proof of every present-day floor. Does not cover 4/F, 27/F, ground floor, podium or roof.

drawing_observations.claim: Three labelled lifts sit in one row with an adjacent electrical meter room. A lift lobby separates the lifts from the stair core.
drawing_observations.limit: No lift capacity, maker, speed, stopping schedule or current operational status.

drawing_observations.claim: The central stair zone depicts two routes entered at opposite ends, with opposed up/down flights.
drawing_observations.interpretation: Consistent with paired, scissor-style stairs. Exact three-dimensional interlock and fire separation are not documented.

drawing_observations.claim: Recesses between B/C and E/F in the lower-range plan are labelled 六樓平台.
drawing_observations.limit: Do not clone these as balconies at every floor.

drawing_observations.claim: The photographed chamber entrance has glazed doors, gold-colour metal framing and a broad canopy/signboard.
drawing_observations.limit: Its relationship to the residential lobby is unknown. Ground-floor layout and compass orientation are unverified.

unknowns: Relationship between the residential main entrance and the chamber entrance.
Rear/service entrance count, position and purpose.
Exact staircase geometry, landing heights and fire compartments.
Window hinge/opening arrangement across facades and units.
Window frame and wall-reveal depth in millimetres.
Variation caused by later window replacements.
modeling_rules: Keep original source geometry and its ID anchored.
Keep real-world evidence separate from design assumptions.
Use 24 only for the tower component and 28 for the whole above-ground building; record the basement separately.
Use plans for topology before metric reconstruction; do not infer equally spaced floors from Storeys alone.
Use parametric window depth/opening defaults only as explicitly labelled design assumptions.
Link to Centaline plans and photos; do not republish them without reuse permission.
publication: Facts, attribution and reference links only. External reference photographs/plans are not redistributed; no reuse license is claimed.
